name: Walking In Your Anointing
overview: Scripture reveals that anointing is a divine empowerment by the Holy Spirit to fulfill God's specific purposes, as seen in the anointing of Jesus to preach good news, heal the brokenhearted, and set captives free (Isaiah 61:1; Luke 4:18; Acts 10:38). Believers are called to walk in this anointing, continuing the works of Christ and even greater, empowered by faith in Him (John 14:12). This anointing is a gracious gift from God that enables effective service and ministry, assured by the unchangeable nature of His gifts and calling (Romans 11:29). The imagery of being anointed with oil, as in Psalms 23:5, symbolizes God's abundant blessing and favor upon His people as they walk in their anointing.
